name: CI/CD Pipeline

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, master, develop ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main, master, develop ]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.9", "3.10", "3.11", "3.12"]

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
          cache: 'pip'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -e ".[dev,security]"
          # Ensure defusedxml and bandit are installed explicitly if not in extras
          pip install defusedxml bandit pytest pytest-cov

      - name: Lint with flake8
        run: |
          pip install flake8
          # stop the build if there are Python syntax errors or undefined names
          flake8 . --count --select=E9,F63,F7,F82 --show-source --statistics
          # exit-zero treats all errors as warnings. The GitHub editor is 127 chars wide
          flake8 . --count --exit-zero --max-complexity=10 --max-line-length=127 --statistics

      - name: Run tests with coverage
        run: |
          pytest tests/ --cov=kicad_mcp --cov-report=xml --cov-report=term-missing

      - name: Upload coverage reports to Codecov
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v4
        with:
          file: ./coverage.xml
          fail_ci_if_error: false

  security-scan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"
          cache: 'pip'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install bandit defusedxml

      - name: Run Bandit security scanner
        run: |
          # Run bandit on the source code, excluding tests and docs
          bandit -r kicad_mcp/ -ll -ii -f custom -o bandit-results.txt || true
          
          # Check if any high severity issues were found
          if grep -q "SEVERITY: HIGH" bandit-results.txt; then
            echo "::error::High severity security issues found by Bandit"
            cat bandit-results.txt
            exit 1
          fi
          
          echo "Bandit scan completed successfully"
          cat bandit-results.txt

      - name: Verify defusedxml usage
        run: |
          # Ensure that unsafe xml.etree.ElementTree is not used directly in production code
          # This is a simple check; more sophisticated AST analysis could be added
          if grep -r "import xml.etree.ElementTree" kicad_mcp/ --include="*.py" | grep -v "defusedxml"; then
            echo "::warning::Potential unsafe XML parsing detected. Ensure defusedxml is used instead."
          fi
          
          # Verify defusedxml is imported where XML parsing occurs
          if grep -r "xml.etree.ElementTree" kicad_mcp/ --include="*.py" | grep -v "defusedxml" | grep -v "test"; then
             echo "::warning::Direct usage of xml.etree.ElementTree detected in production code."
          fi

  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [test, security-scan]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"

      - name: Install build dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install build

      - name: Build package
        run: python -m build

      - name: Upload build artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: dist
          path: dist/
